reason: A DeepSeek Harness web GUI plugin that builds a real-time conversation outline from user questions and Markdown headings, with navigation, highlighting, search, favorites, and overlay panel controls.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供基于会话问题和 Markdown 标题的实时大纲面板，支持定位正文、搜索、收藏和展开控制。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web GUI plugin that provides a real-time outline of conversation questions and Markdown headings with navigation, search, favorites, and expansion controls.

capabilities: Reads session event streams to construct an outline
Displays a draggable overlay outline panel in the DSH web interface
Updates the outline during streaming responses
Navigates to and highlights corresponding conversation content
Provides outline search, expansion controls, favorites, and copy actions
